subject: MedNova: request for custom SLA rider + order form language
messages:
From: Samir Patel <procurement@mednova.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Natalie Bishop <natalie.bishop@mednova.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: custom SLA rider + order form language for MedNova

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at MedNova is preparing the MSA/SOW packet for legal review and we need Redwood to confirm — in writing — a few custom commitments so we can keep our board timeline. High level asks:

- Regional uptime: 99.95% per-region (US-East and US-West) with a defined credit schedule.
- Latency: 95th percentile token latency under 200ms for our steady-state traffic (typical request size ~400 tokens).
- Exception handling: defined maintenance windows, rollback/rollback testing runbook, and proof points for past 12 months.
- Data residency and logging: confirmation that logs for our tenant remain in US regions and can be exported for audits.

Attached is a simple request spreadsheet with the clauses we want to see redlined (MedNova_SLA_Request.xlsx). Can you confirm Redwood can produce an SLA rider we can attach to the MSA and a short order-form snippet we can include in the purchase paperwork? Also please include the path to SOC 2 / incident history evidence and the suggested DocuSign flow.

We'd like to aim for legal review by Friday (2027-06-04). Can you confirm next steps and owners?

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Procurement Manager
MedNova Health

Attachment: MedNova_SLA_Request.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <procurement@mednova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: custom SLA rider + order form language for MedNova

Hi Samir — appreciate the clear ask and the spreadsheet. Looping in Ben (AE) and Lauren (contracts) to own the order form and redline respectively. Quick plan:

1) Redwood will produce an SLA rider draft by EOD Wednesday (2027-06-02) that aligns to your bullets. The rider will include a credit schedule and a per-region uptime table.
2) Ben will provide an "order form snippet" you can drop into the purchase paperwork showing the SKU/tier that maps to 99.95% availability along with pricing uplift.
3) Lauren will lead the legal redline and confirm any non-standard carve-outs.
4) We'll provide the evidence package (SOC 2 summary, 12-month incident history redacted) and a proposed DocuSign envelope for signatures.

A couple of notes up front: our hosted standard for enterprise is typically 99.9% availability; 99.95% is achievable on Redwood Dedicated or with regional-fallback commitments plus a small uplift. We'll surface exact trade-offs in the rider.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call Wednesday 2027-06-02 11:00 AM PT to walk the spreadsheet and confirm pricing impact. Does that work for you?

I'll attach the rider template we plan to start from.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0189

Attachment: Redwood_SLA_Rider_template.docx (docx)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <procurement@mednova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed order-form language and availability options

Hi Samir — following up from today's call. Below is the straightforward language we suggest for the order form and a short, copyable SLA clause for the rider. We will include both in the redline packet.

Order-form snippet (for purchase table):
- Product: Redwood Inference - Dedicated Regional Tier (RNW-Dedicated-US)
- Commitment: 99.95% per-region uptime SLA
- Term: 12 months (auto-renew)
- Pricing uplift: +18% over standard hosted pricing

Suggested SLA rider excerpt (for redline):
"Service Availability. Redwood Inference will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide the Service with 99.95% availability measured on a per-region monthly basis. Availability calculations exclude scheduled maintenance windows and agreed blackout periods. In the event availability falls below the stated target, MedNova will be eligible for service credits as set forth in Section X (Credit Schedule)."

Trade-offs and evidence: 99.95% requires Dedicated pools pinned to your tenancy or a dedicated capacity reservation (we can do contract language that mandates minimum pool size and regional redundancy). If MedNova needs the lower-latency 95th percentile ≤200ms for steady-state requests, we'll propose a "latency assurance" addendum that ties to the Dedicated SKU and a benchmark test we run during onboarding.

I've attached the order-form snippet as a plain-text file for easy copy into your packet.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_orderform_snippet.txt (text)

From: Samir Patel <procurement@mednova.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Natalie Bishop <natalie.bishop@mednova.com>, contracts@mednova.com
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: custom SLA rider + order form language for MedNova

Rishi/Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. The plan looks good and the proposed order-form snippet is acceptable to commercial. A few final asks before we send to legal:

- Please upload the SOC 2 summary and the 12-month incident history to the Drive link you referenced (we need access for our auditors).
- Confirm the DocuSign envelope ID you will use and whether Redwood needs a pre-signed MSA placeholder.
- Confirm the pricing uplift number in writing (+18% on the listed SKU) and whether that price is valid for 30 days.
- Include the latency assurance test plan (how you measure steady-state traffic and the benchmark harness).

If we get these items by EOD Monday 2027-06-07, we can get legal through redlines before our board cut-off. Attaching the procurement tracker with a couple of inline notes (we will attach once you provide the docs).

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Samir Patel
Procurement Manager
MedNova Health

Attachment: MedNova_SLA_Request.xlsx (updated - procurement tracker)
